entries.name: Pine tree
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, tiered faceted canopy (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan names Quaternius static models on poly.pizza, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is PineTree_4 from the same Quaternius Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0) that the broadleaf tree entry uses, so the two read as one set. Of the five PineTree variants it has the leaning, kinked bare trunk and a crown of stacked tiers held high: the silhouette of a Japanese black pine (kuromatsu) at a shrine or on a coast (PineTree_3 is the fuller Christmas-tree conifer). Height 10 m: a mature kuromatsu in a shrine ground, park or coastal windbreak is about 8-15 m (wild ones reach 20+); at 10 m the crown starts near 5 m, so people walk under it, and it stands clearly above the 7 m broadleaf tree. Colours on noon (no green): the canopy is iris over hair, darker than the broadleaf tree's vermilion so it reads as evergreen beside it; the trunk is vermilion over iris, the red-brown bark anime pines are painted with. Static: no clips.
